```
## components/ui/switch.tsx

Purpose: Provides a styled two-state switch component.
Role: Wraps the `@radix-ui/react-switch` primitive, applying project-specific styles using Tailwind CSS via the `cn` utility. It renders a visual switch that can be toggled between checked and unchecked states.
Contents:

* `Switch` (Component): A `React.forwardRef` component wrapping `SwitchPrimitives.Root`.
    * Applies styles to the root element for the track (background, border, transitions, focus states, disabled state).
    * Contains a `SwitchPrimitives.Thumb` component, styled to represent the sliding knob (size, shape, background, shadow, translation on state change).
* **Exports:** `Switch`.
* **Dependencies:** `react`, `@radix-ui/react-switch`, `@/lib/utils`.

## components/ui/textarea.tsx

Purpose: Provides a multi-line text input field.
Role: A basic UI primitive component rendering an HTML `<textarea>` element, styled consistently using Tailwind CSS via cn.
Contents:

* Component: Textarea.
* Props Interface: TextareaProps.
* Imports: React, cn.
* Exports: Textarea.

## package.json

Purpose: Defines the project's metadata, dependencies, and scripts.
Role: Acts as the core manifest file for this Node.js project (using pnpm as the package manager). It lists the project name (`skaldur`), version, specifies scripts for development (`dev`), building (`build`), starting (`start`), and linting (`lint`). It enumerates all production dependencies required to run the application (like `next`, `react`, `zustand`, `@radix-ui/*`, `tailwindcss`, `lucide-react`, `uuid`, `vaul`, `cmdk`, `embla-carousel-react`, `recharts`, `input-otp`) and development dependencies used during development and build processes (like `@types/node`, `@types/react`, `typescript`, `eslint`, `postcss`, `autoprefixer`).
Contents: Contains keys like `name`, `version`, `private`, `scripts`, `dependencies`, `devDependencies`, `packageManager`.
```

```diff

+ "use client";
+ 
+ import { useState } from "react";
+ import { Settings } from "lucide-react";
+ import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
+ import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
+ import { LlmConfiguration } from "@/components/feature/LlmConfiguration";
+ import { useSessionStore } from "@/store/sessionStore";
+ import { LlmSettings } from "@/types";
+ 
+ export function LlmToolbar() {
+   const {
+     sessions,
+     activeSessionUUID,
+     updateInteractionLlm
+   } = useSessionStore();
+ 
+   const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
+   const [interactionLlm, setInteractionLlm] = useState<LlmSettings | null>(null);
+ 
+   const activeSession = activeSessionUUID ? sessions[activeSessionUUID] : null;
+   const isConfigured = activeSession?.messages.length ? activeSession.messages.length > 0 : false;
+ 
+   // Initialize from session settings
+   useState(() => {
+     if (!activeSession) return;
+     setInteractionLlm(activeSession.lockedSettings.interactionLlm);
+   });
+ 
+   const handleSaveConfig = () => {
+     if (!activeSessionUUID || !interactionLlm) return;
+     updateInteractionLlm(activeSessionUUID, interactionLlm);
+     setIsOpen(false);
+   };
+ 
+   if (!interactionLlm) return null;
+ 
+   return (
+     <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 z-10">
+       {isOpen ? (
+         <Card className="p-4 shadow-lg w-96">
+           <div className="space-y-4">
+             <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
+               <h3 className="font-medium">Interaction LLM Settings</h3>
+               <Button
+                 variant="ghost"
+                 size="icon"
+                 onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
+               >
+                 <Settings className="h-5 w-5" />
+               </Button>
+             </div>
+ 
+             {isConfigured ? (
+               <div className="bg-muted p-3 rounded text-sm">
+                 <div><span className="font-medium">Provider:</span> {interactionLlm?.provider}</div>
+                 <div><span className="font-medium">Model:</span> {interactionLlm?.model}</div>
+                 <div><span className="font-medium">Temperature:</span> {interactionLlm?.temperature}</div>
+                 <div><span className="font-medium">Max Tokens:</span> {interactionLlm?.maxTokens}</div>
+               </div>
+             ) : (
+               <>
+                 <LlmConfiguration
+                   settings={interactionLlm}
+                   onChange={setInteractionLlm}
+                   showAdvanced={true}
+                 />
+                 <Button
+                   onClick={handleSaveConfig}
+                   className="w-full mt-2"
+                 >
+                   Save Configuration
+                 </Button>
+               </>
+             )}
+           </div>
+         </Card>
+       ) : (
+         <Button
+           variant="outline"
+           size="icon"
+           onClick={() => setIsOpen(true)}
+           className="bg-background"
+         >
+           <Settings className="h-5 w-5" />
+         </Button>
+       )}
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
```

I've adjusted the layout and styling to achieve the hovering toolbar effect and compact design:

1.  **Hovering Toolbar:**
    *   Modified `MainChatArea.tsx` to use absolute positioning for the toolbar container (`absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 ...`).
    *   Added `pointer-events-none` to the outer container and `pointer-events-auto` to the inner container holding the toolbar, ensuring the toolbar is interactive but doesn't block clicks on the content underneath.
    *   Added `pt-[140px]` (padding-top) to the `HistoryDisplay` container to prevent the initial chat content from being hidden behind the toolbar. *You might need to adjust this pixel value based on the final height of the toolbar.*

2.  **Compact Design:**
    *   Modified `LlmToolbar.tsx` by setting explicit widths (`w-48`) for the `div` elements containing the dropdowns and sliders. This forces them to be narrower.
    *   Shortened the labels "Temperature" and "Max Tokens" to "Temp" and "Tokens" in the read-only view to save space.
    *   Used `truncate` on the Provider and Model names in the read-only view to prevent long names from breaking the layout.
    *   Changed the main `Card` width from `max-w-3xl` to `w-auto` so it shrinks to fit the content.

3.  **Changelog:** Updated `CHANGELOG.md` to reflect the move to an absolutely positioned, hovering toolbar and the width adjustments for compactness.

Now the toolbar should hover at the top center, allow content scrolling underneath, and have a reduced horizontal footprint.

```diff
+         name: 'Gemini 1.5 Flash Preview',
+         providerId: 'google',
+         maxContextTokens: 1048576, // 1M tokens
+         maxOutputTokens: 8192,
+         supportsTemperature: true,
+         supportsSystemPrompt: true, // Assuming true
+         defaultTemperature: 0.7,
+         defaultMaxOutputTokens: 2048,
+       },
+     ],
+   },
+ ];
+ 
+ // Helper functions
+ export function getProviderById(id: string): LlmProviderDetails | undefined {
+   return llmProviderDetails.find(p => p.id === id);
+ }
+ 
+ export function getModelById(modelId: string): LlmModelDetails | undefined {
+   for (const provider of llmProviderDetails) {
+     const model = provider.models.find(m => m.id === modelId);
+     if (model) return model;
+   }
+   return undefined;
+ }
+ 
+ export function getDefaultModelForProvider(providerId: string): LlmModelDetails | undefined {
+   const provider = getProviderById(providerId);
+   return provider?.models[0]; // Default to the first model listed
+ }
+ 
+ export function getDefaultProvider(): LlmProviderDetails {
+     // Let's default to Google if available, otherwise OpenAI, otherwise the first one
+     const google = getProviderById('google');
+     if (google) return google;
+     const openai = getProviderById('openai');
+     if (openai) return openai;
+     return llmProviderDetails[0];
+ }
+ 
+ export function getDefaultSettings(): LlmSettings {
+     const provider = getDefaultProvider();
+     const model = getDefaultModelForProvider(provider.id);
+ 
+     if (!model) {
+         // Fallback if somehow the default provider has no models
+         console.error("Default provider has no models. Falling back.");
+         const fallbackProvider = llmProviderDetails[0];
+         const fallbackModel = fallbackProvider.models[0];
+         return {
+             provider: fallbackProvider.id,
+             model: fallbackModel.id,
+             temperature: fallbackModel.defaultTemperature,
+             maxTokens: fallbackModel.defaultMaxOutputTokens,
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     return {
+         provider: provider.id,
+         model: model.id,
+         temperature: model.defaultTemperature,
+         maxTokens: model.defaultMaxOutputTokens,
+     }
+ }
```

```diff
  
  ### Added
- - Created a new `LlmToolbar` component for displaying Interaction LLM settings in a hovering toolbar
- - Added the toolbar to the main content area for easier access to LLM settings
- - Added collapse/expand functionality to the `LlmToolbar`
+ - Created central LLM configuration file `lib/model_details.ts` with detailed model parameters.
+ - Added Google Gemini 1.5 Pro & Flash models to the configuration.
+ - Added collapse/expand functionality to the `LlmToolbar`.
  
  ### Changed
- - Moved the Interaction LLM settings from the ConfigSidebar to a hovering toolbar in the main content area
- - Updated the MainChatArea component to include the new toolbar
- - Repositioned "+" button in the SessionSidebar to be directly next to the "Sessions" text
- - Converted sidebar components to use only retractable versions instead of fixed desktop versions
- - Removed Interaction LLM settings from the right sidebar (ConfigSidebar) to avoid duplication
- - Simplified the ConfigSidebar to focus only on Destination LLM settings
- - Redesigned the LlmToolbar to be a horizontal, always-visible toolbar at the top of the content area
- - Reorganized LLM settings into a two-line layout with dropdowns on top and sliders on bottom
- - Added direct inline editing of LLM settings without needing to navigate to the sidebar
- - Updated LlmToolbar to be absolutely positioned (hovering) over the content area
- - Made the LlmToolbar more compact horizontally by setting fixed widths for controls
- - Enhanced the LlmToolbar collapse/expand animation using scale and opacity transitions
+ - Refactored LLM settings management to use the central `model_details.ts` configuration.
+ - Set default LLM settings based on the new configuration in `sessionStore.ts`.
+ - Swapped LLM settings locations:
+     - Destination LLM (Provider/Model only) moved to hovering `LlmToolbar`.
+     - Interaction LLM (Provider/Model/Temp/Tokens) moved back to `ConfigSidebar`.
+ - `LlmToolbar` now displays Destination LLM, is hovering, animated, and compact.
+ - `ConfigSidebar` now displays Interaction LLM with sliders and uses central config.
+ - Repositioned "+" button in the SessionSidebar to be directly next to the "Sessions" text.
+ - Converted sidebar components to use only retractable versions instead of fixed desktop versions.
+ - Redesigned the LlmToolbar to be a horizontal, always-visible toolbar at the top of the content area.
+ - Reorganized LLM settings into a two-line layout with dropdowns on top and sliders on bottom.
```
